subject: NovaPay: subprocessor roster & clarification on APAC egress
messages:

Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@novapay.com>

Subject: Request: current subprocessor roster and data path for NovaPay integration

Hi Rachel / Kimberly,

We're finalizing the NovaPay integration checklist and need the latest subprocessor roster + a short explanation of where customer data may transit cross-border. Specifically:

- Full list of subprocessors (name, country, purpose) involved in ingestion, telemetry, analytics, and backups
- Any vendors introduced or changed in the last 90 days
- Whether any subprocessors hold encrypted payloads or key material (KMS/HSM) outside of EU/US
- A simple data-flow sketch or export path that flags APAC hops (SG/HK/IN)

We attached our DPA (novapay_dpa_v2.pdf) for reference. Can you provide the roster and a recommended DPA addendum if there are APAC egress points? We need this for our security review next week.

Appreciate a tight timeline on this — is EOD Friday realistic?

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Lead Security Analyst, NovaPay
security@novapay.com

Subject: Re: Request: current subprocessor roster and data path for NovaPay integration

Hi Laura / NovaPay team,

Thanks for the note — and for attaching the DPA. We've pulled together the current roster and a short summary below; full CSV attached (subprocessors_2028-09-03.csv). High level: no changes to our core serving stack in the last 90 days, but we did add one telemetry/observability partner on 2028-08-20.

Quick answers to your bullets:
- Full subprocessors (summary):
  * EdgeSight Analytics — Singapore (observability/metrics)
  * LogHarbor — Ireland (log aggregation)
  * CloudCache CDN — US (edge caching)
  * KeyVault Partners — US (KMS/HSM managed service for session key escrow)
  * S3-ArchiveCo — US (cold backups)

- Vendors added/changed in last 90 days: EdgeSight Analytics (added 2028-08-20) — see note below.
- Encrypted payloads / key locations: We do not store NovaPay plaintext outside your designated regions. Keys used for telemetry and session management are managed by KeyVault Partners (US). EdgeSight receives telemetry in encrypted streams; EdgeSight does not manage customer root keys but may temporarily cache encrypted KV blobs in SG.
- APAC hops: EdgeSight has an ingest/forwarder in Singapore causing telemetry egress through SG; if you require EU-only telemetry residency we can gate/route NovaPay telemetry to LogHarbor (Ireland) as part of the integration canary.

Next steps I propose:
1) I attached the roster CSV that enumerates the subprocessors and the purpose column.
2) Kimberly can follow up with the detailed egress map and KMS attestations (she's copied).
3) If NovaPay wants a DPA addendum limiting APAC telemetry residency, we can draft an addendum and provide a DocuSign envelope.

Please let us know whether EdgeSight's SG egress is a blocker; happy to provision a telemetry-only EU route as an interim.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Manager, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-04T08:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: current subprocessor roster and data path for NovaPay integration

Laura / team — quick technical follow-up from the infra side. Quoting Rachel's summary above for context.

EdgeSight details: their Singapore relay only handles anonymized telemetry (metrics, aggregated health pings, sampling IDs). Payload encryption scheme: AES-256-GCM end-to-end; payloads are tagged with tenant id and a telemetry session token. We use our KeyVault Partners HSM for session key wrapping; KeyVault's master keys are in the US. EdgeSight's temporary cache does not have access to unwrapped master keys.

If you need HSM attestation, we can provide KeyVault Partners' SOC2 + HSM service description and an excerpt of their key residency statement.

Attached a simple egress diagram (egress_map_sg_kms.png) that shows:
- Ingest -> Redwood frontends (EU) -> Telemetry stream -> (conditional) EdgeSight SG relay -> LogHarbor IE -> Cold archive S3-US

Operational controls we can offer:
- Telemetry routing policy: route NovaPay telemetry to LogHarbor (IE) only (no SG hop)
- Reduced sampling or redaction for PII fields before telemetry leaves EU
- Time-limited temp access for EdgeSight if you approve a short pilot window

If you'd like, Marissa (cc'd) can coordinate the DPA addendum draft and DocuSign workflow.

Kimberly Park
Head of Infrastructure Security, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Rachel / Kimberly,

Thanks — the CSV and diagram are helpful. A couple of clarifying asks before we close our review:

1) Can you confirm whether KeyVault Partners' HSM root keys are escrowed or replicated outside the US? We need an explicit statement for our procurement/crypto team.
2) We'd like a short DPA addendum limiting telemetry residency to EU for production customers. Please draft and send via DocuSign.
3) If you provide a one-week pilot that uses EdgeSight (SG) with redaction + reduced sampling, we will review the telemetry output and escalate to finalize routing decisions.

Please attach KeyVault Partners' SOC2 + HSM statement and the DocuSign link when you respond. If we can get that by COB Monday we can keep to our original timeline.

Regards,
Laura Chen
Lead Security Analyst, NovaPay
security@novapay.com
